createdAt.description: Operational registration timestamp; not part of the synchronised profile version.

lastSeenAt.description: Operational activity timestamp; not part of the synchronised profile version.

disabledAt.description: Operational disablement timestamp, cleared to null on registration or reactivation; not part of the synchronised profile version.

userAgent.description: Descriptive client metadata; excluded from the synchronised profile representation and its version comparison.

platform.description: Descriptive client metadata; excluded from the synchronised profile representation and its version comparison.

appVersion.description: Descriptive client metadata; excluded from the synchronised profile representation and its version comparison.

firestoreTimestamp.description: Firestore timestamp represented as an SDK timestamp object or a serialised string.
